jobs.title: Physical & Facility Security Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Who we are

Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R&D, we deliver real, production-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field.

We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world’s first profitable AV technology company.

 

What you’ll do

As a Physical & Facility Security Engineer, you'll help secure our depots, facilities, fleet vehicles, and critical infrastructure. You'll work closely with our existing physical security team, Facilities, and Operations to protect our sites and equipment.

  • Manage facility access control, including badge systems, visitor management, and camera coverage across depots and offices.
  • Implement physical security controls to prevent theft and unauthorized access to parked and charging fleet vehicles, including OBD ports.
  • Protect on-premises server rooms and edge computing infrastructure.
  • Manage vendor and contractor access, including provisioning and deprovisioning.
  • Partner with the existing CloudKitchens physical security team to support security operations and address coverage gaps.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

 

About the role

We're looking for a Sales Engineer to be the technical partner to our enterprise go to market  team. The Problem to solve

Utility systems weren't built to connect seamlessly with a DER platform. CIS holds the customer record, while ADMS and Grid DERMS drive real-time grid decisions. Each system operates with its own data model, security posture, and review process. You will be the key leader who transforms that fragmentation into a coherent, streamlined integration strategy.

The Role

As the Lead Product Manager (Senior), you will own how EnergyHub connects and integrates with utility operational systems, ensuring we understand our mutual end-customers (CIS), manage distribution grid conditions (OT systems), and unlock automation opportunities that drive value. This is a focused mandate where you will own the utility-facing integration surface end to end. Over time, your team will leverage internal APIs built by core platform teams to solve the "last-mile" challenge, building a robust set of outward connectors and an ecosystem of software vendors and system integration partners.

This role reports to a Director of Product and will collaborate with stakeholders across the company, including other product managers, engineers, data scientists, sales, solutions engineering, and client success.

The team plays a critical role in ensuring the scalability and flexibility of our future by creating a core platform that enables other internal teams to build new features and functionality quickly.

This is an opportunity to join a highly energized team of engineers eager to define and develop key concepts, solve complex challenges with real-world constraints and have a positive impact on our climate future. We are continuing our journey to migrate from a monolithic to a microservices architecture and deliver well defined APIs to the broader organization. The primary focus is to integrate any Distributed Energy Resource (DER) into our platform in a way that enables multiple use cases without compromising quality and scalability.

As a senior engineer, you support our mission by helping drive major initiatives, providing expertise and guidance from past industry experience, and autonomously developing high-quality solutions that balance multiple constraints while ensuring long-term flexibility.

jobs.description_text:
The Role 

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to define and execute the go-to-market strategy for in-house corporate legal teams and drive sales growth in this segment. You’ll bring strategic thinking, legal software expertise, and cross-functional collaboration skills to turn platform capabilities into persuasive positioning, drive campaigns, and influence product prioritization for our customers.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

  • Own go-to-market strategy for selling Everlaw to legal teams, including messaging, positioning, battlecards, and sales materials (e.g. pitch decks, cheat sheets) that support the enterprise sales motion.
  • Execute product launches for in-house corporate legal teams, developing launch campaigns and positioning, and managing sales enablement and go-live coordination.
  • Partner with Demand Gen and Content to develop omni-channel campaigns and customer-facing collateral (webinars, blogs, whitepapers) that build thought leadership, generate pipeline and grow revenue.
  • Research legal team needs and competitor approaches to identify where we're different and what drives buying decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product and GTM on product prioritization and align on where we should invest and how to compete.

jobs.description_text:
Everlaw is looking for our Senior Information Systems Engineer. As the most senior technical member of the team you will report directly to the IT Director and co-architect our key systems and processes. We will work in an AI Native, GitOps forward approach to develop highly scalable, resilient and secure systems. You're a good fit for the role if your first instinct is “We can script an automation for this” and “Let’s Terraform it”.      

Expect to work in Claude Code shipping changes daily to our Github Repository. Candidates must have strong work experience deploying applications on AWS with Terraform and building CI/CD pipelines. You will run build, buy and SaaS vs. self host trade off analysis to choose the best systems for the business requirements. You have demonstrated experience lifting the technical ability of the entire department through active mentorship, setting best practices, creating reusable templates and modular code. In turn, you will receive mentorship from a hands-on engineering forward IT Director who has run DevOps transformations to scale companies at every stage from seed to IPO.      

We are building an IT department for the future, candidates should bring a strong technical vision and enjoy testing new software platforms and deploying the latest technologies.

jobs.description_text:
The Role

As Senior Manager, User Experience Research, you'll lead Everlaw's user research function as a strategic player-coach, uncover foundational insights, bring clarity to complex problems and shape the future of our AI-powered litigation platform. You will partner with cross-functional leaders to focus research capacity on the highest-impact questions, personally lead strategic studies, and turn insights into compelling narratives that influence product strategy and priorities. In this role, you will build a durable understanding of our customers, elevate research craft, scale the practice through thoughtful democratization and AI-enabled tools, and develop researchers to do their best work. 

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

How we’re different

  • Built for the AI Era: Everlaw has been committed to AI-assisted workflows for over a decade with tools like predictive coding, document clustering, and ML translation. We’ve continued this leadership into the generative AI era, with best-in-class AI features like deep dive and coding suggestions built with principled design, rigorous controls, and deep workflow expertise. jobs.description_text:
1891

 

Signal Integrity Measurement Engineer

Location: Austin

About the Role

Validate signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) for advanced compute platforms, focusing on hands-on measurement, electrical compliance, troubleshooting, and simulation correlation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop measurement plans and design of experiments (DOE) for board-to-board, cable, backplane, blade-, and rack-level interconnects.
  • Measure scattering parameters (S-parameters), insertion loss, return loss, impedance, crosstalk, eye diagrams, jitter, timing margins, and bit error rates.
  • Design printed circuit board (PCB) test fixtures; perform calibration, de-embedding, and electrical compliance testing against interface specifications and customer requirements.
  • Correlate measurements with simulations and troubleshoot issues with silicon, package, board, and system teams, interconnect vendors, and original design manufacturers (ODMs).

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Robotics & World Models
jobs.description_text:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

 

Scope of the Role: 

Progress in physical AI is gated as much by data design as by model architecture. The best manipulation and locomotion policies, vision-language-action models, and world models are only as good as the trajectories, demonstrations, and environments they learn from — so the highest-leverage decisions are made long before a model trains: what to capture, what to synthesize, how to represent an action, and how to know whether any of it will transfer to a real robot. Innodata is building the data and evaluation practice behind the next generation of robotics foundation models, in direct partnership with the customers and frontier labs defining that frontier. We are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science of that data.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Automation Engineer
jobs.description_text:
As a Manufacturing Automation Engineer at Lexington Medical, you will design the fixtures and specify the robotics and automation equipment that build a surgical stapler, then scale those processes as production volume grows. This is an entry-level role built for an engineer coming out of school, and the work is real from the start: the fixture you design gets installed on a line that is running, and you will be on the floor when it does. Manufacturing, engineering, and quality all work in the same building in Bedford, so the loop between designing something and finding out whether it worked is short. 

About Lexington Medical 

Lexington Medical designs and manufactures AEON™ surgical stapling technology at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts, just outside Boston. Our products are used in minimally invasive surgery, where precision, reliability, and quality matter every time. Because engineering, manufacturing, and quality work together under one roof, the people building and supporting our products are close to both the process and the decisions behind it.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Manager
jobs.description_text:
As a Mechanical Engineering Manager at Lexington Medical, you will lead a team of mechanical and product engineers designing surgical staplers from concept to production. You will help shape how the team plans, reviews, and delivers its work while staying close to the engineering itself. The instruments your team designs move from CAD and bench testing into operating rooms, and you will own that path from the first requirements to the Design History File. 

About Lexington Medical 

Lexington Medical is a medical device company designing and manufacturing surgical stapling technology at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts, just outside Boston. Our AEON(TM) Endoscopic stapler is an FDA-cleared, minimally invasive surgical stapler used in operating rooms around the world. With engineering, manufacturing, and quality working closely together, engineers stay close to the product and see their work move from an idea through prototyping, testing, manufacturing, and ultimately into the operating room.
